Zoning and business: three zone types (residential / commercial / industrial) painted on cells without street pieces, zone-to-building organic growth in density steps (low to high), R/C/I demand bars in sim view, job slots per commercial / industrial density step. Per-tick zone growth: every Nth tick (GROWTH_INTERVAL_TICKS = 20, ~5s at 4Hz default) every zoned cell with density < 3 advances by 1. Density step gating on per-cell supply / demand from citizens (REQ-075), power (REQ-085), water (REQ-090), and services (REQ-100) lands as the follow-on; v1 ships unconditional growth so the player sees the system advance immediately.

Power grid: two v1 plant types (coal 100MW, solar 30MW) with 2x2 footprints, single-cell power-line pieces forming connected components, per-tick connectivity solver assigning powered / brownout / unpowered to each demanding cell, drive-mode visible signal (lit windows at night for powered residential, dark for browned out), per-cell pollution from coal plants feeding into citizen happiness.

Water and sewage: two source types (water-tower 50, pump-station 200), single-cell pipe pieces, sewage waste production per populated cell flowing toward sewage-treatment plants via dedicated sewage pipes, per-tick connectivity solver mirroring REQ-087 shape, drive-visible water towers and treatment plants (pipes invisible underground).

Economy: per-tick tax revenue from populated zones (rates default residential 7%, commercial 7%, industrial 5%), one-time build cost on infrastructure placement, per-tick maintenance cost on placed infrastructure, top-of-screen treasury HUD with monthly net income / loss and tax rate sliders, bankruptcy after 30 in-game days below zero treasury (offers reset budget or reset city).

Services: five v1 service buildings (police-station, fire-station, hospital, school, garbage-depot) each with fixed coverage radius and per-tick maintenance cost, per-tick coverage solver per service-type for every populated cell, citizen happiness penalty per missing service-type, service-specific behaviors (police lower crime, fire lower fire-disaster spawn, hospital lower sickness, school raise property value, garbage prevent garbage accumulation), drive-visible service buildings with active-event signals.
